fact: UNHCR says it and the Government registered 3,619 new arrivals (684 households) in northern Cote d'Ivoire from April to June 2026, and registered new arrivals receive refugee attestations or other documents that provide proof of identity.
UNHCR says continuous registration and verification are recording refugees and asylum-seekers in the national refugee database and giving them documentation, with DAARA as the government counterpart.
UNHCR reports 29,233 refugees registered on an individual basis with DAARA in 2024 and 5,014 people assisted with civil status documents.
